editorial:
Imagine getting back together with an old best friend for a quick getaway, only to realize they aren't acting like themselves at all. That is exactly what happens to Mandy when she reunites with Lisa. At first, it seems like a typical weekend of catching up and having a blast, but the vibe shifts quickly. You will find yourself questioning everything as Lisa starts behaving in ways that are just plain weird. It feels like a puzzle where you are trying to figure out if Lisa is going through a crisis or if there is something much darker happening behind the scenes.

The acting is really solid and makes the tension feel real, though the pacing slows down a bit in the middle. You will love the surprises, even if some parts feel a little predictable. It is a great pick if you enjoy character studies that blend laughs with a bit of a mystery. It is a cozy but creepy watch that works best on a rainy night.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that Lisa is not who she seems to be. After Mandy spends the weekend worrying about her friend, it turns out that the strange behavior was part of a larger deception. The movie wraps up with a shocking realization about identity and betrayal. Once the truth comes out, the friendship is shattered, leaving you to wonder how well you actually know the people closest to you in your own life.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological twists and friendship dramas.
